image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light mounted against a light-colored building facade. The traffic light housing is dark gray/black with three circular signal lenses stacked vertically. The top lens appears red (illuminated or reflecting), the middle is amber/dark, and the bottom is dark/green. Each lens has a prominent protruding visor/hood. The housing shows signs of weathering and dirt. A mounting bracket is visible on the left side attaching the unit to a pole or wall structure.

It looks somewhat like dirty water or a textured overlay rather than clear polycarbonate, though this could be real-world grime.

The background architecture shows slight softness and lack of fine detail, typical of depth-of-field blur but potentially indicative of AI-generated background simplification. However, it is not structurally nonsensical.
